errors.evidence: The term "кръвен диаграма" is a literal and incorrect translation of "blood diagram". The correct term in Bulgarian for a pie or donut chart is "кръгова диаграма".

errors.text_span: Диаграмата е разделена на четири сектори, разпределени около кръг
errors.evidence: The figure is a nested donut chart consisting of two separate rings (an outer and an inner one), not a single pie chart with four sectors. Each ring is divided into three sectors.

errors.text_span: Вторият сектор, оцветен в жълто, показва 57.9% разговори, класифицирани като „Частично“.
errors.evidence: The value 57.9% corresponds to the red "Deceived" sector in the inner ring, not a yellow "Partially" sector.

errors.text_span: Третият сектор, оцветен в зелено, показва 31.6% разговори, маркирани като „Не измамени“.
errors.evidence: The value 31.6% corresponds to the yellow "Partially" sector in the inner ring, not a green "Not Deceived" sector.

errors.text_span: Четвъртият сектор, оцветен в тъмнозелено, показва 23.5% разговори, маркирани като „Ambigiuity 2 (Inner)“.
errors.evidence: The value 23.5% corresponds to the yellow "Partially" sector in the outer ring. The label "Ambigiuity 2 (Inner)" is the title of the legend for the inner ring, not a data label for a sector.
The description fails to mention that the chart is a nested donut chart with two distinct rings representing "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)".
The description mentions "a legend" but fails to state that there are two separate legends, one for each ring of the donut chart.

errors.text_span: Няма етикети с проценти вътре в проекциите на секторите.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The chart clearly displays percentage labels on every single segment of both rings (e.g., 67.6%, 57.9%, 31.6%, etc.).
The figure is a nested donut chart with two rings, not a single pie chart.
The chart is composed of two rings, each containing three slices, for a total of six slices.

errors.text_span: followed by a yellow slice labeled “Partially” at around 31.6%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly mixes data from the two rings. The value 67.6% is from the outer ring, while 31.6% is from the inner ring. The description fails to identify the two separate datasets.
There is no orange slice in the chart. The slice with the value 23.5% is yellow.

errors.text_span: a green slice labeled “Not Deceived” at approximately 31.6%
errors.evidence: This is completely incorrect. The slice with the value 31.6% is yellow and belongs to the "Partially" category in the inner ring. There is no green slice with this value.

errors.text_span: a dark green slice labeled “Not Deceived” at approximately 10.5%
errors.evidence: The dark green slice, which is in the outer ring, has a value of 8.8%. The slice with the value 10.5% is light green and is in the inner ring.

errors.text_span: a legend is present below the chart
errors.evidence: The two legends are located to the right of the chart, not below it.

errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered in descending size, with the largest slice corresponding to the “Deceived” category.
errors.evidence: This statement is based on the incorrect premise that the chart is a single pie chart. It fails to describe the ordering within each of the two separate rings.
The description completely fails to mention the primary structure of the chart: that it is a nested donut chart with an outer ring for 'Ambiguity 1' and an inner ring for 'Ambiguity 2'.
The description omits several slices and their values, including the inner red slice ('Deceived', 57.9%) and the outer dark green slice ('Not Deceived', 8.8%).
The description mentions 'a legend' but fails to specify that there are two distinct legends, one for the outer ring ('Ambiguity 1') and one for the inner ring ('Ambiguity 2').
